notes: Real mapping for the termination-fee family (P1). Both sides render through components/review/table-configs/termination-fees.config.js selectRows() with the per-family gate flags OFF, so each side reaches the row builders via the config's `const cards = legacyCards.length ? legacyCards : canonicalCards` path (:1253). That holds the renderer constant and attributes every difference to the DATA. Row key is `id` alone: the config's ids are already stable and semantic (termination-fees-COMPANY_TERMINATION_FEE, termination-fees-interest, ...), and label is derived from id, so adding label to the key would only hide id drift. Deferred-evidence rows carry a content-hash suffix in their id and therefore never join across sources; that is correct, because an open-world evidence row has no legacy counterpart by construction.

fields.notes: The row identity. Also the row key, so it is always equal on a joined row; declared because the harness requires every key component to be a declared field.
Row label as rendered in the Term column.
Amount / Condition / Remedy / Evidence. A kind change on a joined id means the two sources disagree about what type of fact the row states.

The rendered value line. For fee rows this is formatFeeDetail() output and carries % of equity value, raw amount, payer/payee, payment deadline and sole-remedy status, so a V2 side missing any of those shows up here.
Whether the row asserts a positive finding. Present-on-one-side-only is reported, never skipped.
Raw feature value behind a scalar row. Absent on fee rows and evidence rows.
Verbatim clause text shown in the Provision column. quote kind, so a shorter V2 string is reported as V2_LOSS rather than a bare disagreement.
The pill set. For a fee row this carries the amount signal plus one pill per trigger, so a trigger V2 failed to corroborate is visible here and nowhere else.
Short title of the card the row drew from. Differs by construction between a legacy classifier card and a canonical projection card; recorded rather than skipped so the substitution is never silent.
Citation of the clause the row is anchored to. A citation disagreement is the strongest single signal that the two sides are describing different provisions.
Which registry features fed the row. Drives the market sidebar, so a V2 loss here silently removes the row from market statistics.
NOT_YET_EXTRACTED / PARTIAL_NOT_YET_EXTRACTED. Distinguishes an honest V2 coverage admission from a silent V2 loss, which is the distinction this whole exercise turns on.
